svg.title: Celadon — combination mark
svg.desc: The Celadon organic-crackle glaze tile beside the Celadon wordmark set in Fraunces (baked to paths). The deep-glaze sage wordmark reads on light or dark backgrounds.

g.title: Celadon — logo
g.desc: A sage celadon glaze tile with a generated organic ice-crackle network: meandering fracture lines welded at natural junctions, a primary/secondary width hierarchy, and a few cells pooled a touch deeper. Reads on any background.
